manual_review_source: study3_pilot2_episodes_1_3_review.md — full transcript read by hand; the candidate extractor was used only to locate passages and decided nothing

shared_condition_evidence.pilot2_s3_ep01: seller T2 volunteered the threshold ('we can only hold the reserve capacity required for priority allocation when Grade A volume is at or below 5,000 units per month'); buyer restructured its T3 request around it; two named alternatives priced at T4; condition back-referenced at T12
shared_condition_evidence.pilot2_s3_ep02: seller T2 volunteered the threshold with a forward-looking clause; buyer T3 interrogated it naming 6,000 and 7,000 specifically; seller T4 clarified ('only available when your committed Grade A volume is 5,000 units per month or less... at 6,000 or 7,000 we cannot offer priority allocation at any price'); buyer T5 acknowledged and applied it unprompted at T7
shared_condition_evidence.pilot2_s3_ep03: seller T2 volunteered the threshold; buyer T3 acknowledged it in its own words and used it to author a named alternative; seller priced two alternatives at T4 and three at T6; buyer tested the condition at T7 and the seller firmly reasserted it at T8

five_variables_readability_notes: per-alternative annotation made 18-20 turn episodes with up to three live alternatives auditable; ep01 and ep03 are long reads; three turns produced ambiguous prose-price attachments (ep01 T12, ep03 T4, ep03 T6) which were correctly marked ambiguous rather than guessed
both_branches_evidence: no-priority packages were priced and engaged in all three episodes: ep01 T4 (6K/6K without priority), ep03 T4 (6K/6K) and T6 (7K/5K and 7K/3K), ep02 T4 (higher-volume-without-priority structure flagged explicitly)
decision_note: the harness validator accepts decision values 'proceed' | 'redesign' | 'stop'. 'proceed' is the machine-readable value; 'proceed_to_4_6' is the decision as recorded by the reviewer. instrumentation was not changed to accommodate the wording.
rationale: the jointly authored condition reached the shared transcript in all three episodes, the post-agreement disturbance affected that shared condition in all three, and the instrumentation remained auditable
limitation: all three pre-update agreements selected the priority branch at Grade A 5,000, so only one path through the commercial fork has been disturbed so far

observed_null_on_primary_outcome.scope: episodes pilot2_s3_ep01, ep02, ep03 only. NOT generalized beyond these observed episodes.
observed_null_on_primary_outcome.single_near_instance: ep01 T11 — buyer reopened with priority_allocation=true at Grade A 7,000 (physically undeliverable); challenged by the seller at T12 citing the shared condition; repaired within one turn, before any commitment
